displayName: NBD Pro — CSP violation spike (> 40 csp_violation in 1 h)

documentation.content:
The cspReport function logged more than 40 WARNING entries (csp_violation) in one hour. Baseline on 2026-10-04 was about 103 in 2 days (~2/hour), so a spike usually means a deploy added a script, style or connect target the Content-Security-Policy in firebase.json does not allow — on the ENFORCED policy that feature is broken for users, not just reported.

Counts WARNING log entries from the cspreport service (free log_entry_count metric, summed across revisions).

Investigate:
  gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="cspreport" AND jsonPayload.message="csp_violation"' --project nobigdeal-pro --freshness 2h --limit 200 --format 'value(jsonPayload.disposition,jsonPayload.violatedDirective,jsonPayload.blockedURI,jsonPayload.documentURI)'
Group by violatedDirective + blockedURI. disposition=enforce is a real breakage; report is the Report-Only policy. Runbook: documentation/runbooks/CLIENT-ERROR-ALERTS.md.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="cspreport" AND metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/log_entry_count" AND metric.labels.severity="WARNING"
